questions.question: Buyer’s market denotes the place where ________.

options.text: commodities are available at competitive rates
the demand and supply are well balanced

questions.solution: Buyer’s market denotes the place where the supply exceeds the demand. In this type of market, the buyers have the advantage of price negotiation. If the demand exceeds the supply then such type of market situation is called Seller’s market.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an example of intermontane plateau?
questions.solution: Intermontane plateau refers to those plateaus which are surrounded by mountains. They are the highest plateaus of the world. Plateau of Tibet, Columbia Plateau, and Bolivian Plateau are the example of the intermontane plateau.

questions.question: Tawa River is the tributary of which of the following river?
questions.solution: Tawa River is the tributary of Narmada river. It is the longest tributary of Narmada river. Its origin is in the Satpura range. It meets the Narmada at Hoshangabad district. Its length is 172 km.

questions.question: The Sanskrit poet Rajshekhar lived in the court of ________.
questions.solution: The Sanskrit poet Rajshekhar lived in the court of Mahendrapala I. He wrote the Kavyamimamsa. It is a practical guide for poets in which he has explained the elements and composition of a good poem. He is best known for his play ‘Karpuramanjari’.

questions.question: Which of the following Mughal rulers started 'Jharokha Darshan'?
questions.solution: Akbar started 'Jharokha Darshan'. It was a means to address the public audience at the balcony at forts and palaces. It facilitated face-to-face communication with the public. This practice was abolished by Aurangzeb as he considered it a non-Islamic practice.

questions.question: If an atom has atomic number 10 and mass number 23, then what will be the number of protons and neutrons in an atom respectively?
questions.solution:
__**Explanation:**__

We know that,

**Atomic Number = Number of Protons/ Electrons**

Here, Atomic Number = 10

Thus, No. Of Protons = 10

Mass Number = Number of Protons + Number of Neutrons

Here, Mass Number = 23

Number of Protons + Number of Neutrons = 23

Number of Neutrons = 23 – 10 = 13

__**∴ Number of Protons = 10 and Number of Neutrons = 13**__

questions.question:
Which among the following writs can be issued against any private individual?

I. Certiorari

II. Prohibition

III. Habeas Corpus
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Habeas Corpus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Habeas Corpus can be issued **against any private individual.**
 
• Habeas Corpus in simple terms **means to have a body'.**__
 
• It is a type of writ which is issued under** Article 32.**
 
• Other writs mentioned in the same article are

 
• **Mandamus- **command to perform a public duty.
 
• **Prohibition**- command to the court to stop proceedings.
 
• **Certiorari-** issued by the court to transfer a case.
 
• **Quo-warranto**- issue to inquire the legality of a claim of a public officer.

 
• It is issued by** the court.**

questions.question: Which type of epithelial tissue forms the lining of kidney tubules and ducts of salivary glands, where it provides mechanical support?
questions.solution: Epithelial tissue forms a lining all over the body of the organism in order to protect the inner lying parts. They act as a barrier that keep the different body systems separate. Cuboidal epithelial tissue forms the lining of kidney tubules and ducts of salivary glands, where it provides mechanical support.

questions.question: The cell walls of many organisms of Fungi kingdom are made of a tough complex sugar called which among the following?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Chitin__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Chitin is a **naturally occurring biopolymer, **which is a **polymer** created by an **organism.**
 
• Chitin is the **second most abundant natural biopolymer** in the world,** behind only cellulose.**
 
• Chitin is found in the** exoskeletons of insects, the cell walls of fungi.**
 
• Chitin is also found in the **cell walls of certain fungi and algae.**
 
• Chitin** **forms **a rigid cell wall between cells, which help the organisms retain their shape.**
 
• **Chitin is not a protein** but is similar to **protein.**
 
• **Chitin behaves** similarly to **keratin.**
 
• Chitin is made up of **amino sugars.**
 
• Chitin is a **biodegradable molecule** that **dissolves over time.**
 
• Chitin is a** large, structural polysaccharide** made from **chains of modified glucose.**
 
 
• **Structure of Chitin:**
 
 

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/909afffa90a96efd6f984cee0667471dfd56aaee93d39d4e82e8f93c3ba1c392.png] **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**Name**__
 __**Description**__
 
 

 **Suberin**
 
 
 
• Suberin is a **complex biopolymer** found on the **inner face of primary cell walls **in aerial and **root parts of the plant.**
 
• Suberin is built from **poly-functional long-chain fatty acids (suberin acids) and glycerol. **
 
• Suberin is **insoluble in organic solvents.**
 
• Suberin is a **cell wall constituent that forms gas and watertight layers.**
 
 
 
 

 **Pectin**
 
 
 
• Pectin, any of** a group of water-soluble carbohydrate substances that are found in the cell walls and intercellular tissues of certain plants.**
 
• Pectin is a **soluble fibre known as a polysaccharide,** which is **a long chain of indigestible sugars.**
 
• Pectin is a fibre and contains almost **no calories or nutrients.**
 
• **Two main types of Pectin:**
 
 
• High methoxyl (HM), and
 
• Low methoxyl (LM).
 
 
 
• Pectin is **primarily used** in **food production and home cooking as a thickener.**
 
 
 
 

 **Cellulose**
 
 
 
• Cellulose is** a complex carbohydrate,** or **polysaccharide, consisting of 3,000 or more glucose units.**
 
• Cellulose forms via **β(1 - 4) - glycosidic bonds between D-glucose units.**
 
• The mic**rofibrils (Several polysaccharide chains are arranged in parallel arrays)** of cellulose are **extremely tough and inflexible** due to the **presence of hydrogen bonds.**
 
• Humans **cannot digest** cellulose, but it is **important in the diet as a source of fibre.**

questions.question: What is the name of the asteroid that causes Geminid meteor shower display around 15 December of every year?
questions.solution: 3200 Phaethon is the name of the asteroid that causes Geminid meteor shower display around 15 December of every year. 3200 Phaethon is an Apollo Asteroid and it is believed that it might have undergone a collision with another object in the distant past to produce the stream of particles that Earth, which we call the meteor shower. When it approaches Sun, it sheds a huge amount of rock and dust in its path and Earth happens to pass that path every year during December 4-16.

questions.question: In October 2017, RBI planned to make _________ compulsory for companies having aggregate exposure over Rs. 5 crore.
questions.solution: RBI planned to make Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) compulsory for companies having aggregate exposure over Rs. 5 crore in October 2017. LEI is a unique 20 digit alphanumeric code used for global reference. It uniquely identifies every legal entity or structure that is party to a financial transaction, in any jurisdiction.

questions.question: On January 16, 2018, the Supreme Court ruled the attacks and interference on adults opting for inter-caste marriage as ‘absolutely illegal’ in the petition filed by which NGO in 2010?
questions.solution: On January 16, 2018, the Supreme Court ruled the attacks and interference on adults opting for inter-caste marriage as ‘absolutely illegal’ in the petition filed by Shakti Vahini NGO in 2010. The court was hearing a 2010 petition by NGO Shakti Vahini against *khap *panchayats seeking directions to the centre and state governments for preventing honour crimes.

questions.question: Find the acceleration (in m/s²) produced in a body of mass 2 kg when a force of 8 N is applied to it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

We know that,

Force = mass × acceleration

8 = 2 × acceleration

Acceleration = 4 m/s²

questions.question: An object having a capability to do work is said to possess __________.
questions.solution: An object having a capability to do work is said to possess energy. The SI unit of energy is joule (J). There are various forms of energy like Kinetic energy, Potential energy, Chemical energy, Mechanical energy, Heat energy etc.. And according to the law of Conservation of Energy, energy can neither be created nor destroyed, it can only be converted from one form to another.

questions.question: The ozone layer protects us from harmful _________ rays of the sun.
questions.solution: The ozone layer protects us from harmful Ultraviolet rays of the sun. It is present in Earth’s Stratosphere. It absorbs 97 to 99 percent of the Sun's medium-frequency UV light. It is being depleted continuously by chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs). 16 September is celebrated as the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer.

questions.question: In MS-Excel, ________ is an excellent tool for presenting data in an attractive format in a worksheet, which helps in analyzing and comparing data.
questions.solution: In MS-Excel, Charts are an excellent tool to present data in a worksheet in a visually appealing format which aids in analyzing and comparing data.
